subject: SIG questionnaire — new edition change, re-answers and evidence plan
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@acmecorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: SecurityOps Team <security@acmecorp.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG edition update and re-answer request

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the prior SIG submission. Our compliance team has just published a new SIG edition ("SIG edition 2026-06") that introduces changes to several control questions and adds a new sub-section for "runtime telemetry retention." Attached is a diff workbook that maps changed questions to prior answers (SIG_edition_diff.xlsx).

Can Redwood provide:
- A list of re-answered questions (CSV or spreadsheet) highlighting any changes from your previous submission
- Evidence artifacts for changed items (access logs, config screenshots, policy docs) or links to a secure drive
- A short summary of any controls you cannot re-answer in the new schema and your plan to address them

Target timeline: initial re-answers by EOD Tue Jul 13 for our intake review; final evidence by Jul 20. If you need an extension, please let us know and explain which controls require more time.

Attachments: SIG_edition_diff.xlsx (workbook with question diffs)

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Senior InfoSec Program Manager
Acme Corp

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG edition update and re-answer request

Alice,

Appreciate the heads up and the diff workbook. We'll take this on. High level plan:

1) Internal intake and triage today (assign owners per control) — Ben
2) Draft re-answers and a first-pass evidence bundle (CSV + links) by Tue Jul 13 (target) — security lead (Mina)
3) Internal review and any remaining evidence collection Wed/Thu Jul 14-15
4) Final package to you by Tue Jul 20

We will attach the initial draft re-answers to this thread (SIG_reanswers_v3.csv) for your intake review; that file contains a column with our previous answer and a proposed updated answer plus a short rationale where the answer changed. Where evidence is non-trivial (access logs, audited configs) we'll upload a password-protected archive to the Drive link and send you the access tokens via secure channel.

If Acme has an absolute freeze on changes for any critical control, flag them in your reply and we'll prioritize.

Attachments: SIG_reanswers_v3.csv (draft re-answers)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: FW: SIG edition update and re-answer request — internal ask

Team — forwarding Acme's request and our draft re-answers. Action items below, please confirm ownership: 

- Mina: Review controls in tab 'Runtime & Telemetry' in SIG_reanswers_v3.csv. We need: 1) confirmation of retention schedule, 2) an export (logs) slice for June 2026 showing retention metadata, and 3) a short paragraph on how caching and KV prefixing affect telemetry sampling.
- Karthik: Where the draft indicates a change to encryption/keys, please produce the key management diagram and the KMS policy snippet.
- Ben: I'll coordinate packaging and external delivery; make sure we redact any PII in logs.

I've attached the draft re-answers again for quick reference. We'll aim to hand off a sanitized evidence bundle to Alice by EOD today; if anything slips, call out blockers in the thread.

Ben / Karthik,

Confirmed — I've reviewed the 'Runtime & Telemetry' tab and updated three rows where retention language needed to reflect our current 90-day KV cache retention and 365-day aggregated telemetry retention. Evidence I will provide:
- access_logs_2026-06.zip (sanitized logs, will strip IPs and redact user IDs)
- kms_key_policy_snippet.txt (policy excerpt)
- telemetry_retention_policy.pdf (internal doc excerpt)

I'll upload the artifacts to the secure Drive folder and post the link here once the upload completes (will be there before 17:00 PT). If Acme needs a signed statement for any item, let me know and I'll route to Legal.

—Mina

If you'd like, Mina is available for a 30-minute walkthrough of the evidence set tomorrow morning PT to expedite intake review — propose Wed Jul 14 at 09:30 or 10:30 PT.
